body:
Few things are more encouraging for me as a writer than learning that congregations are using my books to strengthen their spiritual lives and alignment. Crescenta Valley UMC tweeted this photo of art that was inspired by The Great Spiritual Migration . So beautiful!

 So many congregations are stuck in ruts of gross uncreativity disguised as fidelity to tradition. If God is Creator, then creativity is essential to fidelity!

 If your congregation would like to use one of my books for a congregation-wide study, check out the options here.  Each book has a carefully-constructed set of discussion questions, designed to stimulate reflection, conversation, and action.
